title: Tanh
subtitle: Hyperbolic · Sigmoid-like
summary: Hyperbolic tangent. Range (−1, 1). Used as a neural network activation.
detail:
\[ \tanh x = \frac{\sinh x}{\cosh x} = \frac{e^x-e^{-x}}{e^x+e^{-x}} \]

Odd function. Range \((-1,1)\), with horizontal asymptotes at \(\pm 1\). Derivative: \(\operatorname{sech}^2 x=1-\tanh^2 x\). Used as an activation function in neural networks (zero-centred, unlike sigmoid).
